articles.summary: FLOWER MOUND, Texas, Aug. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX ), ("Mannatech" or "Company"), global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its second quarter of 2026. Second Quarter Results Net sales for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were $26.7 million, an increase of $1.0 million, as compared to the same period in 2025. On a Constant dollar basis (see Non-GAAP Measures, below)
articles.title: Mannatech Reports Financial Results for Second Quarter 2026
